pages.title: Forge a Vessel for Souls
pages.text: At the Smithing Table, place Spirit Core as template, Lead as base, and Primordial Qi as addition. An empty vessel can contain one vanilla or modded creature.

pages.title: Capture and Release
pages.text: Use on a creature to preserve its complete entity data. A filled catcher glints and names the occupant in its tooltip. Use it on valid empty ground to release. Creative mode also replaces the held stack correctly.

pages.title: A Reincarnation Specimen
pages.text: A filled catcher can supply the Simulated Reincarnation Furnace with its specimen. Capture and release are disabled during tribulation so the active target flow cannot be bypassed.
